mean_cn: n.钱包（尤指女用的），小钱袋，手袋；资金，财源；  v.使皱起，噘起
mean_en: a small bag made of leather, plastic, etc. for carrying coins and often also paper money, cards, etc., used especially by women; the amount of money that is available to a person, an organization or a government to spend
sentence_trans: 这个钱包装了一些硬币。
